source.note: Sprites captured from live CSS rendering; source HTML/CSS files were not modified.

coordinateSystem.towerAnchor: Pivot corresponds to the current CSS entity position before translate(-50%, -68%).
coordinateSystem.centeredAnchor: Enemies, projectiles, impacts, range rings and tiles use centered pivots.

godotHints: For the 1920x1080 port, start with godot_1080p_1_5x where one board tile is 105x105 px.
Import textures with Filter set to Nearest or project default texture filter set to Nearest.
Use pivotPx for Sprite2D offset/origin alignment when using trimmed PNGs or atlas regions.
Tiles are untrimmed; use them directly in a TileSet with tile size equal to tilePixels.
Reference board PNGs are visual guides, not required runtime sprites.
